decisions.reason: The check-in app builds on the firm's established aviation passenger-handling business and its in-house technology development, which lets it learn from early results, though the pandemic slump in air travel and the missing 2020–2021 web evidence raise the risk of withdrawal.

PassBoard sits closest to the firm's core passenger screening and processing know-how and was formally launched as a flagship product, so the firm is well placed to interpret results and refine it as air traffic recovers.

The self-service check-in solution complements the firm's airport and airline offer and draws on its own technology team, but weak airline demand during the pandemic and the lack of later web presence leave a moderate chance it is discontinued.
